title: Build a 1.5.0 -> master update delta so the reporter can verify the download fixes - no 1.5.1, the fix ships to everyone in 2.0
description: MPI-717's three download fixes (MPI-716 telemetry, MPI-718 retry budget, MPI-719 scan race) can only be verified on the reporter's own machine: no link here sustains 20-40 KB/s and nothing here reproduces real mid-transfer blips. Fabio 2026-09-11: NO 1.5.1 - the 1.5.x line is already set up so its next update is 2.0, and a patch release there is the whole release loop for one verification. He gets MASTER as an update-only delta over his 1.5.0 install; the fix then ships to everyone in 2.0 with his run as the evidence. Measured: SCHEMA_VERSION is 4 both sides so his projects are safe, engine core pin is identical but master adds 5 custom nodes, and master's APP_VERSION 1.4.2 is LOWER than his 1.5.0 - so the build must be stamped ahead with --version or the update checker offers him 1.5.0 and reverts it. Procedure and every trap: tasks/MPI-720/brief.md.
